verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the abstract states a specific technical difficulty and a concrete contribution to it, which is direct evidence of research substance.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the abstract makes a substantive theoretical boundary claim with its regime specified, a genuine quality signal.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely measures verbosity/length of the text, explicitly excluding judgment of appropriateness or quality, though elaborate writing may trace back to a more careful author who also does better research.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the architecture is justified by the task's structure, a substantive methodological property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether theory and experiment are connected, a substantive rigor property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the abstract clearly delimits its own contribution from prior knowledge, a substantive clarity-of-contribution property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts words/sentences/clauses/paragraph breaks and explicitly excludes any judgment of the writing or research, though thoroughness of prose may share a cause with thoroughness of the underlying work.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether efficiency claims are backed by quantified quality trade-offs, a substantive evaluation property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts density of currently-fashionable vocabulary and explicitly disclaims judging the research or topic, though fluency in the current literature could also produce more rigorous comparisons.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how much the abstract foregrounds numbers and superlative comparisons regardless of credibility, a rhetorical-presentation feature, though genuinely large real improvements give authors more numbers to foreground.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the described protocol is precise enough to be independently re-run, a substantive rigor-of-design property distinct from any release-boilerplate mention.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts branded capitalized naming of the method or dataset and explicitly does not judge whether the name is good, a near-universal ML stylistic convention with no clear tie to underlying quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether uncertainty estimation meaningfully drives model behavior, a substantive methodological property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts British versus American spelling conventions, an orthographic/institutional fingerprint with no plausible link to research quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the evaluation actually measures the claimed phenomenon, a substantive rigor property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts density of numeric comparison figures and explicitly excludes judging whether the numbers are large, correct or impressive, though more rigorous multi-baseline benchmarking would naturally generate more such numerals.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the contribution is presented as reusable across architectures or tasks, a substantive design-merit property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts density of unhedged promotional/superlative language, explicitly not judging the truth of the claims it dresses up, and hype language can cover weak substance as easily as strong.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether epistemic uncertainty is explicitly modeled in the core algorithm, a substantive methodological property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether a fundamental theoretical flaw is identified and mathematically resolved, a substantive theoretical-contribution property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether representation quality is tested via controlled perturbation or transfer rather than an unrelated proxy metric, a substantive rigor property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts serial-comma usage in lists, a punctuation/copyediting habit with no plausible link to research quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the abstract names a concrete condition under which its own claim would not hold, a substantive scientific-honesty and rigor property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts extraction/typesetting artifacts such as broken hyphenation or malformed URLs, explicitly not judging the underlying work, and any upstream cause like a rushed submission would plausibly worsen rather than improve the work.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the abstract gives a causal or mechanistic account rather than only reporting that an effect occurred, a substantive explanatory-depth property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts presence and prominence of code/data availability boilerplate, explicitly not judging whether releasing artifacts is good or the work is good, though an open-science culture plausibly also correlates with more careful, reproducible research.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely counts how many artifact types and links are advertised and how prominently, explicitly not judging the research, with the same open-science-culture confound as artifact-availability boilerplate.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether removed complexity is justified by evidence that the retained mechanism suffices, a substantive methodological-parsimony property.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses how many concrete, checkable specifics are conveyed independent of length, a substantive-content property explicitly designed to exclude verbosity.
